steps.title: One consumer
steps.desc: dsh-tool-web registers web_search and web_fetch; it never imports a concrete provider.

steps.title: Into the seam
steps.desc: ctx.web.search()/fetch() is the tool's only path into the WebRuntime.

steps.title: Resolve per call
steps.desc: resolveProvider selects fresh on every call, not once at boot.

steps.title: Pick a provider
steps.desc: Configured id wins; several usable providers with no config throw WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS.

steps.title: Seam-side cap
steps.desc: capSources truncates sources[] to maxResults and sets truncated, regardless of vendor.

steps.title: Fetch branch
steps.desc: dsh-web-fetch-http retrieves an arbitrary URL directly — a live SSRF boundary.
